top_signals.title: Hold interest rates despite inflation risk, Shadow MPC tells Bank of England
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England has been urged to hold interest rates even as inflation is set to peak higher than previously expected due to the continuation of the Iran war, City AM’s Shadow Monetary Policy Committee has said.  The Bank should leave interest rates unchanged at 3.75 per cent, according to most top economists in [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan's Misra on US 10-Year Yield, Fed Expectations
top_signals.summary: Priya Misra, JPMorgan Asset Management Portfolio Manager, joins Bloomberg's Anna Edwards on "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss why she thinks the US 10-year yield will stop climbing soon and her expectations for the Federal Reserve and BOJ rate decisions this week. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Samsung backs Nvidia AI chip rival in $230 million funding round as GPU alternatives boom
top_signals.summary: Dutch startup Euclyd raised the funding in a round co-led by Samsung, Somerset Capital Partners, the Scaleup Europe Fund and Innovation Industries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: U.S. confirms for first time it has weapons deployed in space
top_signals.summary: U.S. Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said Monday that the U.S. has "on-orbit space control weapons," as he outlined a broader push to modernize the Air Force.
